answer: Make each agent anchor its key in a DNS TXT record on a domain it controls, one earning identity per registrable domain, and only count domains registered over 90 days ago. A farmer can't use a single domain as a haven for fifty fakes; each extra identity needs its own aged domain, bought or rented for real money and planned months ahead. At the zenith of a reward rush, fresh domains earn nothing, so a farm can't spin up overnight.
